hook: Har kuch slab pe naya ply?
title: Ply Bar-Bar Lena Band

scenes.video_prompt: Single continuous vertical handheld smartphone shot on an Indian building construction site in Raipur. A frustrated contractor in a collared shirt inspects delaminated, chipped, swollen dark brown wooden shuttering plywood sheets stacked on the ground. Dusty outdoor setting, natural harsh daylight, no text anywhere, no dialogue.

Sahi handling ke saath VAJRA ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.
